reran: The 19 KB generated program crashed with EmptyScope.enter in constructors on the integration build. I shrank it to class C[@specialized(Int) A](val a: A) { val b: Int = Option(a) match { case Some(x) if x == a => 1; case Some(_) => 2; case None => 3 } }, replaced repro/Test.scala and re-recorded actual.txt: EmptyScope.enter during constructors on the integration build, the base and 2.13.18; 2.12.20 the same. Scala 3.7.4 compiles it and prints 1.
user_impact: A class with a specialized field whose constructor body contains a block with a local val of a class type, or a pattern match on an extractor: class C[@specialized(Int) A](val a: A) { val b = { val t = Option(a); t.isEmpty } } crashes the back end ('Error while emitting', NullaryMethodType), and a match with a guard gives EmptyScope.enter. Field initialisers with a match or a temporary in a specialized class are everyday code; both tickets have been open since 2013 and 2016 with duplicates.
fixability: clear cut in principle: Constructors.mergeConstructors copies the generic class's constructor statements into the specialized subclass and retypes them with Duplicators in the template's typer context, whose owner is the class, so a block-local val is entered as a member (printed as private[this] val x1, referenced as C$mcI$sp.this.x1). Retype with the constructor as owner. No compatibility cost, the programs do not compile today.
regression: no (2.12.20 crashes the same way; scala/bug#7574 was reported against 2.10)
links: scala/bug#8172 and #8320 were closed as duplicates of these; scala/bug#8156 (open) is probably the same cause. No earlier wave finding covers it; H2, H61, H63 and SP1 are other defects of constructors in specialized classes.
note: The crash does not need the 100-line program, a partial function, or try: the EmptyScope.enter message is a secondary effect (after the local becomes a member, an assignment in the match translation is retyped as a setter call and the typer falls back to an implicit search after typer). The simpler trigger gives 'Error while emitting ... NullaryMethodType', the symptom recorded in scala/bug#10096, whose tree dump matches what -Xprint:constructors shows here. The statements are copied only when the constructor uses a specialized member, which reading the specialized parameter does. I kept the EmptyScope form in repro/ so the title still matches. The finding's prior field says none found for the message; the cause is known.
